text.p: Alexion Pharmaceuticals Inc said Friday the United States Patent and Trademark Office issued a patent relating to the company's xenotransplantation program.
The U.S. patent covers the genetic engineering of mammalian cells with a human complement inhibitor.
The company said the patent was issued to the Oklahoma Medical Research Foundation and Yale University and is exclusively licensed to Alexion.

"We believe that this issued patent further strengthens our position in the field of xenotransplantation, and is an important addition to our growing intellectual property portfolio," said Leonard Bell, M.D., chief executive of Alexion.
